children: Sweden lighting equipment maker's Q3 net sales rose 7.9% yr/yr, driven by organic growth
Earnings improved, helped by SEK 15 mln U.S. tariff refund and lower costs
Company saw strong sales growth in Americas and EMEA, offset by APAC decline
Company says market conditions remain challenging with strong global competition
Profoto does not expect any rapid change in market sentiment
Company expects Profoto ProPanel to contribute to sales over time as adoption increases
TARIFF REFUND - Earnings were positively impacted by a SEK 15 mln refund of U.S. tariffs
COST CONTROL - Improved earnings were driven by lower costs, thanks to continued strong cost control
PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT - Launch of Profoto ProPanel LED-panel is progressing as planned and is being used in productions worldwide
